items.note: Five classroom experiments in which university student groups completed design-thinking assignments with or without generative AI, and the creativity of group solutions was evaluated; assignment method and N not stated, and the unit is groups.
Current Opinion narrative review of gains and constraints of creative collaboration with GenAI and four moderators; not systematic and no meta-analysis, so useful only as a source of leads.

98 advertising professionals randomly assigned to no GenAI, GenAI, or GenAI after prompt training for an ideation task; outcomes are idea count and creativity (check whether 'perceived creativity' is rater-scored or self-reported).

Responses from three ChatGPT versions compared with human responses on open and closed creative tasks, rated blind by 738 raters (4,428 evaluations); no participant used AI; same study as SSRN 4686415.

Experts and nonexperts wrote ad copy without an LLM, with an LLM as ghostwriter, or with an LLM as sounding board; ad quality measured by real social-media clicks and semantic divergence analyzed; assignment method and N not in abstract.

Abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, Europe PMC, Springer page all failed); title suggests a study of personalized GenAI on student creative performance, self-efficacy, and attention, design unknown.

Eight-week high-school study (38 experimental, 32 control) in which both groups used GenAI and only the experimental group got metacognitive scaffolding; creative performance improved; the contrast is scaffolding within GenAI use, so check whether it counts as a different AI configuration.

Two experiments: participants worked on simple and complex creative tasks with a human partner versus an unconstrained LLM partner (Exp 1), then with batch-responsive versus constrained-responsive LLMs (Exp 2); individual creativity scored; N and assignment not in abstract.

12-week quasi-experiment in three vocational-school classes (75 students): no GenAI, GenAI, and GenAI with teacher structure support; pre-post creativity measured on fluency, flexibility, elaboration, originality, likely a creativity test (check whether taken with or without AI).

Difference-in-differences on 43,587 designers after a platform added a GenAI illustration tool; outcome is the volume of original postings and domain reallocation, not novelty, originality, or diversity of the work.
